title: LeaderboardSnapshot
description: Durable snapshot of the top-N leaderboard. Source: docs/EDD.md §4.6; docs/SCHEMA.md §2.5 leaderboard_snapshots. The class diagram label was clarified to LeaderboardSnapshot in commit 56f64fa to match SCHEMA. The live, authoritative leaderboard is the Redis sorted set leaderboard:global; this table is the durable backup used for historical reporting.

snapshotTime.description: UTC timestamp of when the snapshot was captured.
